clips.title: The story
paras: In Orgrimmar, poisoned rogues seek Hinott's Assistance before Zanzil's mixture claims their lives. The toxin came from an infiltration in the Barrens, and Serge Hinott in Tarren Mill can offer a cure and teach the brewing of poisons.

A daring infiltration of the Venture Company's tower north of the Sludge Fen leaves rogues poisoned by Zanzil's altered mixture. It dulls their reflexes and threatens their lives. Shenthul, the rogue trainer in Orgrimmar, knows local remedies cannot help. He sends the poisoned rogue across the sea to the Eastern Kingdoms for care.

The search for a cure leads south through Lordaeron to Tarren Mill, a village in Hillsbrad Foothills. Serge Hinott lives there as an apothecary, known for his fascination with virulent brews. Ordinary healers recoil from Zanzil's venom, but Hinott treats the deadly compound with professional glee. He can dissect the foul concoction and teach worthy rogues to brew their own venoms.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Take a sample of the mixture to Serge Hinott in Tarren Mill.
If anyone can cure you, it's Serge. Live long enough and Serge will show you the ways of poison creation and use.

clips.title: Completion
paras: You look deliciously pale, adventurer. And what is that foul aroma you are giving off? I must know!
